persons.name: Jayatejavarman
persons.evidence: śrījayatejavarmaṇenaḥ śva〇hastena svārtham idaṃ kālottaramahātantra likhitam

relations.evidence: śrījuvarājāddhirājaśrīśrījayajyotimalladevasya rājyavijayarājye likhita pustakaṃ ... śrījayatejavarmaṇenaḥ śva〇hastena ... likhitam

date.as_written: samvat 538 śrāvaṇakṛṣṇe | trayodaśyāyā tithau || punavasunakṣatre || , śu〇ddhiyoge || āditavāsareḥ

notes: Jayatejavarman explicitly wrote the text with his own hand for himself (śvahastena svārtham ... likhitam). The ruler is given the title juvarājāddhirāja (yuvarājādhirāja).
